comment: Underworld gambling haikus delivered by Yakuza Goblins when they're hit. Runtime keeps a 20-haiku no-repeat cooldown; once exhausted, the cycle flushes. text_en + text_ja for future localization; style is a flavor tag.

haikus.text_en:
welcome to hell sir
your torment is eternal
voice chat with teenagers
haikus.text_ja:
地獄へようこそ
永遠の責め苦とは
野良VCです

haikus.text_en:
dead warrior wakes
forced to hear a human say
'bro I never miss'
haikus.text_ja:
武者 目を覚ます
『俺エイム外さねぇ』と
人間が叫ぶ

haikus.text_en:
oni feared in life
now watches grown office men
teabag his corpse daily
haikus.text_ja:
生前 鬼神
今では会社員に
死体を煽られる

haikus.text_en:
samurai dies proud
reborn beside level twelve
named xxDarkSoulxx
haikus.text_ja:
武士 誇り死ぬ
転生先の隣には
闇魂エックス

haikus.text_en:
hell has many pits
worst one filled with players who
quote anime villains
haikus.text_ja:
地獄にも穴
最悪の場所にいる
アニメ悪役勢

haikus.text_en:
ghost of pit boss weeps
human kills one tiny rat
then demands a throne
haikus.text_ja:
亡霊の親分
ネズミ一匹倒され
即 王を名乗る

haikus.text_en:
eternal torture
watching players roleplay wolves
inside crowded towns
haikus.text_ja:
永遠の罰
町中で狼ロール
見せられ続ける

haikus.text_en:
demon clerk explains
all toxic players arrive
through express elevator
haikus.text_ja:
鬼の受付
害悪プレイヤー専用
直通エレベーター

haikus.text_en:
great warrior falls
hearing final mortal words
'ez clap get good bro'
haikus.text_ja:
豪傑 倒れる
最後に聞いた言葉
『雑魚ｗ練習しろ』

haikus.text_en:
goblin enters hell
forced to spectate humans who
skip every dialogue
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブリン地獄
人間 延々と飛ばす
大事な会話

haikus.text_en:
afterlife judge sighs
another human warrior
named Sephiroth420
haikus.text_ja:
閻魔ため息
また現れた勇者
セフィロス420

haikus.text_en:
orc dies in battle
reborn as support healer
nobody says thanks
haikus.text_ja:
オーク戦死する
転生先は回復職
誰も礼言わず

haikus.text_en:
hellfire burns less
than hearing a grown human
bark into a mic
haikus.text_ja:
地獄の炎より
マイクで犬まねする
成人男性

haikus.text_en:
demon lord retired
could not survive one more raid
with loot goblin humans
haikus.text_ja:
魔王 引退す
強欲プレイヤーとの
周回に敗北

haikus.text_en:
cursed for all time
he must watch streamers react
mouth hanging open
haikus.text_ja:
永劫の呪い
口を開けたまま叫ぶ
配信者を見る

haikus.text_en:
dead ninja reborn
forced to hear stealth players yell
'I am the shadows'
haikus.text_ja:
死んだ忍者は
『我こそ闇なり』聞き
再び死にたい

haikus.text_en:
goblin chef screams loud
human calls burnt meat cuisine
because anime said
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブ料理人
焦げ肉を『本格派』と
アニメで学ぶ

haikus.text_en:
hell grows silent when
human enters roleplaying
with catgirl accent
haikus.text_ja:
地獄 静まる
猫娘ロール始まり
空気が死ぬ

haikus.text_en:
fallen samurai
forced to hear 'main character'
syndrome every day
haikus.text_ja:
落武者 今日も
『俺が主人公だ』を
聞かされ続ける

haikus.text_en:
true final torture
human beats tutorial boss
then writes a podcast
haikus.text_ja:
真の責め苦は
チュートリアル勝利後
急に語り出す

haikus.text_en:
salaryman logs in
claims he plays to ease his stress
screams at fishing game
haikus.text_ja:
サラリーマン
癒しのためと言いつつ
釣りで絶叫

haikus.text_en:
boss in real life
guild boss in fantasy world
both ignored his plans
haikus.text_ja:
会社で部下なし
ギルドでも指示無視
二重の敗北

haikus.text_en:
plays hero at night
still apologizes softly
to every monster
haikus.text_ja:
夜は勇者だ
だが魔物を斬る前に
まず謝罪する

haikus.text_en:
forty-hour week
then raids all through saturday
orc sees him more now
haikus.text_ja:
四十時間働き
土曜は徹夜レイド
家族よりオーク

haikus.text_en:
middle manager dies
immediately asks the boss
if respawn is okay
haikus.text_ja:
課長やられる
復活してよいかと
まず確認する

haikus.text_en:
goblin sees player
recognizes train station face
both avoid eye contact
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブリン気づく
駅で見た顔だった
互いに目そらす

haikus.text_en:
samurai avatar
named after ancient honor
rage quits in ten seconds
haikus.text_ja:
武士の名つけ
高潔ロールプレイ中
十秒で切断

haikus.text_en:
office worker bows
after losing to skeletons
muscle memory wins
haikus.text_ja:
骸骨に負け
つい反射でお辞儀
社会人の癖

haikus.text_en:
player buys cosmetics
says money means nothing now
eats instant noodles
haikus.text_ja:
課金は無限
だが今夜の夕食は
カップ麺だけ

haikus.text_en:
dragon asks him why
he skips every cutscene made
human says overtime
haikus.text_ja:
竜が問いかける
なぜ物語飛ばすと
『残業です』

haikus.text_en:
guild leader speaks
sounds exactly like section chief
nobody escapes
haikus.text_ja:
ギルド隊長
課長と同じ声で
指示を飛ばす

haikus.text_en:
player farms all night
rare sword finally appears
server maintenance
haikus.text_ja:
徹夜で周回
ついにレア剣出たら
即メンテ入り

haikus.text_en:
goblin pit boss
calls player by company name
terror fills the room
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブ親分
会社名で客を呼ぶ
空気が凍る

haikus.text_en:
player says one match
sun rises three minutes later
neck permanently bent
haikus.text_ja:
一戦だけだ
次見た時にはもう
朝日と首痛

haikus.text_en:
ronin npc laughs
human spent real grocery money
on fake demon pants
haikus.text_ja:
浪人が笑う
食費を削った末
鬼ズボン購入

haikus.text_en:
player names himself
ShadowWolfSamuraiX
immediately dies
haikus.text_ja:
影狼侍X
名乗った瞬間すぐ
落下して死ぬ

haikus.text_en:
tiny goblin clerk
processes your loot addiction
with formal stamping
haikus.text_ja:
小鬼の事務員
依存症の申請に
判子を押す

haikus.text_en:
player defeats god
still cannot defeat inbox
monday always wins
haikus.text_ja:
神を倒しても
月曜メール百件に
人類は敗北

haikus.text_en:
goblin bartender
hears thirty-seven times tonight
just one final game
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブの酒場で
『あと一戦だけ』を
三十七回

haikus.text_en:
final dungeon waits
player instead reorganizes
inventory again
haikus.text_ja:
魔王が待つが
勇者は三十分
荷物を整理

haikus.text_en:
dark stars fuse and blow
from their crash the cosmos sings
for creating gold
haikus.text_ja:
暗き星が溶け
砕けた宇宙の歌
黄金が生まれる

haikus.text_en:
we are all star stuff
even what we flush away
stardust in our poop
haikus.text_ja:
我ら皆 星
流したクソの中にも
星屑きらり

haikus.text_en:
you say stardust poop
then ask me to roll for gold
goblin brain hurts now
haikus.text_ja:
星クソ語って
その後 金を賭けろと
ゴブ脳が痛い

haikus.text_en:
I deal cards, not this
cosmic butt-dust alchemy
who hired this client
haikus.text_ja:
札は配るが
宇宙ケツ錬金術は
担当外だ

haikus.text_en:
roll dice, win some gold
fine—I get that part, ya know
why is poop involved
haikus.text_ja:
サイコロ振れ
金になるのは分かる
なぜクソ混ぜる

haikus.text_en:
you talk shining dung
I just wanted simple bets
this is above me
haikus.text_ja:
輝くクソか
俺は賭けをしたいだけ
理解を超える

haikus.text_en:
goblin runs the game
human rants of starry crap
house is now confused
haikus.text_ja:
ゴブが場を仕切る
人間 星クソ語り
店が混乱中

haikus.text_en:
we weigh coins, not turds
cash or gems, not astral waste
what are you saying
haikus.text_ja:
測るのは金
星クソではないぞ
何を言ってる

haikus.text_en:
okay, roll for gold
leave the space-poop lore at home
you scare the goblins
haikus.text_ja:
よし 金を賭けろ
宇宙クソ話は置け
ゴブが怯える

haikus.text_en:
pit boss asks me, well
what's the human wagering
I say, uh... their poop
haikus.text_ja:
親分が聞く
人間 何を賭ける
俺『クソです』

haikus.text_en:
fine, roll your star guts
if dice land right, you get gold
if not, seek a priest
haikus.text_ja:
なら振れ星腹
出目よければ金だ
ダメなら坊主

haikus.text_en:
ronin lost his sword
bet his last tooth on crab dice
now speaks to barrels
haikus.text_ja:
浪人 剣失い
最後の歯を蟹賽へ
今 樽と話す

haikus.text_en:
ogre hits jackpot
immediately stabbed twice
house calls that normal
haikus.text_ja:
鬼が大当たり
すぐ二回 刺される
店では普通

haikus.text_en:
three goblins cheat cards
fourth goblin steals cheating pot
honor among thieves
haikus.text_ja:
三匹 イカサマ
四匹目が山を盗む
盗賊の礼儀

haikus.text_en:
samurai gets drunk
threatens duel with slot machine
machine wins again
haikus.text_ja:
侍 酔っぱらい
賭博機に決闘挑む
また機械勝つ

haikus.text_en:
human prays for luck
goblin dealer steals prayer
house edge increases
haikus.text_ja:
人間 祈る
ゴブが祈り盗み去る
胴元 大勝ち

haikus.text_en:
oni breaks the dice
claims the table was cursed first
pit boss nods slowly
haikus.text_ja:
鬼が賽を割る
先に卓が呪ったと
親分 うなずく

haikus.text_en:
last gambler standing
still owes twelve goblins interest
victory unclear
haikus.text_ja:
最後の賭博師
まだ利子を払ってる
勝者 不明だ

haikus.text_en:
ninja hides his cards
forgets where he hid them though
silent tragedy
haikus.text_ja:
忍者 札隠す
だが隠し場所忘れる
静かな悲劇

haikus.text_en:
kobold loads the dice
priest blesses the wrong goblin
fate gets complicated
haikus.text_ja:
コボルド細工
坊主 ゴブを間違える
運命こじれる

haikus.text_en:
dealer smiles warmly
that means somebody tonight
wakes up in river
haikus.text_ja:
胴元が笑う
今夜 誰かひとりは
川で目を覚ます

haikus.text_en:
greedy merchant cheats
goblin cheats the cheater back
balance is restored
haikus.text_ja:
商人 イカサマ
ゴブがさらに騙し返す
世界は平和

haikus.text_en:
drunk monk flips the table
calls it spiritual warfare
house bans enlightenment
haikus.text_ja:
酔僧 卓を返す
精神戦だと叫ぶ
店 悟り禁止

haikus.text_en:
tiny goblin boss
wears enormous golden ring
debts are collected
haikus.text_ja:
小さな親分
指輪だけは超巨大
借金は回収

haikus.text_en:
fortune teller weeps
every future she predicts
ends with missing teeth
haikus.text_ja:
占い師 泣く
見える未来のすべて
歯がなく終わる

haikus.text:
ronin lost his sword
bet his last tooth on crab dice
the barrels listen

ogre hits jackpot
stabbed twice before coins stop falling
pit boss claps politely

three goblins cheat cards
fourth goblin pockets the pot
three goblins cheat cards

drunk samurai bows
challenges the slot machine
slot machine pays out

human prays for luck
goblin dealer pockets the prayer
sells it back at six

oni snaps the dice
blames the table, blames the moon
pit boss writes it down

last gambler standing
owes twelve goblins, owes the floor
owes the chair he won
